purpose: Compare baseline and zg in complete read-only QA with Claude Code + Qwen3.8-Max, using one existing SWE-QA task and one new closed-issue task.

agent.name: claude-code
agent.repository_guidance: disabled using CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY; fresh HOME, empty setting sources

retrieval.query_policy: Preserve native main MCP schema and instructions (including its semantic-search guidance); no additional benchmark-specific tool forcing.
retrieval.index_setup: before timed solver; cloned per trial; separately recorded

tasks.selection_reason: Existing selection.json gate.smoke_task, chosen before new outcomes.
Closed issue with resolvable merged fix, multi-file code-grounded causal chain, scenario-only question; no model-output screening.

run_plan.minimum_validation: One case for each route, one baseline/zg pair for each. Fix infrastructure before interpreting outcomes. No automatic suite expansion.
run_plan.after_validation: Report each complete pair with source-grounded quality, full metrics and actual zg adoption; choose next development iteration based on observed mechanism rather than changing gold or selecting a winning rerun.

scoring.primary: Frozen claim-based source-grounded quality and citation validity, scored with profile hidden.
resource_metrics: wall seconds including container and MCP startup
scoring.cost: Claude-reported dollars are unverified for third-party models; not treated as real billing.
scoring.failure_policy: Retain every attempted run and its failure. Failed/unfinished answers cannot be claimed as efficiency wins.

scope_limits: Two development tasks, not a representative population or statistical proof.
Newer public source does not establish absence from model training.
Read/Grep/Glob-only isolated Claude protocol differs from published full Harbor agent; only within-pilot comparisons isolate zg availability.
Reflex source-corrected rubric is separate from official SWE-QA judge; the original needs_update wording is inaccurate.
No task removal, trimming or post-outcome prompt adjustment in confirmation trials.
Uses current-main Rust and local embedding; earlier cancelled Node preparations are superseded and excluded from results.

preflight_invalid_attempts.reason: Cancelled after offline native CLI test showed --bare suppresses Grep/Glob; no valid paired outcome. Native tool exposure is now mandatory before paid trials.
Stopped when user clarified current main Rust requirement; Node runtime experiment superseded, no completed paired outcome accepted.

Pinned Rust runtime built and offline root checks passed, but non-root index preparation could not read a root-owned model-cache completion marker. No task inference started. Repair cache readability and require non-root offline smoke before the unchanged pair.
